scoring_justification: Cannot recompute band gaps from raw artifacts (only the final CSV is available), so result-level comparison with tolerance is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold DFT band gap values for pure, 2at%, 5.1at%, 6.2at% Mg-doped anatase
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3.4 states: pure 3.24 eV, 2 at% 3.23 eV, 5.1 at% 3.10 eV, 6.2 at% 3.05 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published article PDF.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values, traceable to the paper.

outputs.description: Computed DFT band gap energies for pure anatase and Mg-doped anatase at 2 at.%, 5.1 at.%, and 6.2 at.% doping levels.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads this CSV, extracts the four band gap values, and compares each to the paper-reported values with an absolute tolerance of ±0.1 eV. All four must pass; reward is proportional to number of matches.
